violation_type.title: Arrangement of Napping Equipment -Sufficient Walking and Work Space (26 TAC §747.2809(3))
violation_type.short_title: Arrangement of Napping Equipment -Sufficient Walking and Work Space
violation_type.typical_finding: Child was observed napping on a cot between the bed and the closet,  having very little space to move.

finding_variants.text: Child was observed napping on a cot between the bed and the closet,  having very little space to move.
The children were sleeping on cots placed close together  which did not allow sufficient walk through.     The permit holder corrected it by spacing the cots.
